meta.title: Critical Moment
meta.description: To advance or retreat is dangerous; thus we should wait for a chance.

units.rawText: Reverse Babylon Tower, Plaza of Oaths.
units.displayText: Reverse Babylon Tower, Plaza of Oaths.

spans.text: Reverse Babylon Tower, Plaza of Oaths.

units.rawText: ...That is why Eucharist betrayed the Sanctifiers?
units.displayText: ...That is why Eucharist betrayed the Sanctifiers?

spans.text: ...That is why Eucharist betrayed the Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: I only revealed the truth. The right to choose was forever in her hands.
units.displayText: I only revealed the truth. The right to choose was forever in her hands.

spans.text: I only revealed the truth. The right to choose was forever in her hands.

units.rawText: She chose to accept her real self and become an Entropic.
units.displayText: She chose to accept her real self and become an Entropic.

spans.text: She chose to accept her real self and become an Entropic.

units.rawText: Sophistry and deception.
units.displayText: Sophistry and deception.

spans.text: Sophistry and deception.

units.rawText: A flame-cloaked slash travels through the air with a roar. Eosphorus only retreats backwards, his face cold.
units.displayText: A flame-cloaked slash travels through the air with a roar. Eosphorus only retreats backwards, his face cold.

spans.text: A flame-cloaked slash travels through the air with a roar. Eosphorus only retreats backwards, his face cold.

units.rawText: This is not something you should be concerned with, Eosphorus. True dangers are rarely visible upon the surface.
units.displayText: This is not something you should be concerned with, Eosphorus. True dangers are rarely visible upon the surface.

spans.text: This is not something you should be concerned with, Eosphorus. True dangers are rarely visible upon the surface.

units.rawText: When the Reverse Babylon Tower falls fully under my control, such concerns of identity will no longer be important.
units.displayText: When the Reverse Babylon Tower falls fully under my control, such concerns of identity will no longer be important.

spans.text: When the Reverse Babylon Tower falls fully under my control, such concerns of identity will no longer be important.

units.rawText: When the Sacred Canon is fully Entropized, redemption shall come for all of you.
units.displayText: When the Sacred Canon is fully Entropized, redemption shall come for all of you.

spans.text: When the Sacred Canon is fully Entropized, redemption shall come for all of you.

units.rawText: ...I will not allow that.
units.displayText: ...I will not allow that.

spans.text: ...I will not allow that.

units.rawText: Such things are not decided by you and I...
units.displayText: Such things are not decided by you and I...

spans.text: Such things are not decided by you and I...

units.rawText: Or rather, did you really think that I would let Professor <cmdr> into the Tower without prior preparations?
units.displayText: Or rather, did you really think that I would let Professor {교수} into the Tower without prior preparations?

spans.text: Or rather, did you really think that I would let Professor
into the Tower without prior preparations?

units.rawText: Noise injects itself into Hesperus' auditory modules. He instinctively moves to remove it, but finds himself unwittingly dragged into Sanctifier communication channels.
units.displayText: Noise injects itself into Hesperus' auditory modules. He instinctively moves to remove it, but finds himself unwittingly dragged into Sanctifier communication channels.

spans.text: Noise injects itself into Hesperus' auditory modules. He instinctively moves to remove it, but finds himself unwittingly dragged into Sanctifier communication channels.

units.rawText: Does Eosphorus speak true?
units.displayText: Does Eosphorus speak true?

spans.text: Does Eosphorus speak true?

units.rawText: I struggle to believe it... Lady Angelus is... an Entropic?
units.displayText: I struggle to believe it... Lady Angelus is... an Entropic?

spans.text: I struggle to believe it... Lady Angelus is... an Entropic?

units.rawText: Should we still follow and fight for Lady Angelus?
units.displayText: Should we still follow and fight for Lady Angelus?

spans.text: Should we still follow and fight for Lady Angelus?

units.rawText: The Sanctifier leader pauses, realizing the gravity of the situation.
units.displayText: The Sanctifier leader pauses, realizing the gravity of the situation.

spans.text: The Sanctifier leader pauses, realizing the gravity of the situation.

units.rawText: ...Eosphorus!
units.displayText: ...Eosphorus!

spans.text: ...Eosphorus!

units.rawText: You're quite late to notice.
units.displayText: You're quite late to notice.

spans.text: You're quite late to notice.

units.rawText: Allowing <cmdr> to come into contact with the Sacred Canon and to explain the truth of Eucharist's situation, I did for the sake of one objective.
units.displayText: Allowing {교수} to come into contact with the Sacred Canon and to explain the truth of Eucharist's situation, I did for the sake of one objective.

spans.text: Allowing
to come into contact with the Sacred Canon and to explain the truth of Eucharist's situation, I did for the sake of one objective.

units.rawText: He ascends to an easily visible location in the center of the battlefield, his unhampered voice spreading to every corner of the field.
units.displayText: He ascends to an easily visible location in the center of the battlefield, his unhampered voice spreading to every corner of the field.

spans.text: He ascends to an easily visible location in the center of the battlefield, his unhampered voice spreading to every corner of the field.

units.rawText: Hear me, compatriots! Abandon your arms!
units.displayText: Hear me, compatriots! Abandon your arms!

spans.text: Hear me, compatriots! Abandon your arms!

units.rawText: What you have just heard is the complete truth, undeniable in its veracity.
units.displayText: What you have just heard is the complete truth, undeniable in its veracity.

spans.text: What you have just heard is the complete truth, undeniable in its veracity.

units.rawText: The Sacred Canon's Entropization is irreversible. <cmdr>'s plan was doomed to fail from the very beginning.
units.displayText: The Sacred Canon's Entropization is irreversible. {교수}'s plan was doomed to fail from the very beginning.

spans.text: The Sacred Canon's Entropization is irreversible.
's plan was doomed to fail from the very beginning.

units.rawText: Even if you continue the battle here, you only delay the inevitable. I trust that such meaningless sacrifice is not something anyone desires to see.
units.displayText: Even if you continue the battle here, you only delay the inevitable. I trust that such meaningless sacrifice is not something anyone desires to see.

spans.text: Even if you continue the battle here, you only delay the inevitable. I trust that such meaningless sacrifice is not something anyone desires to see.

units.rawText: Some attacks signifying denial come from the Sanctifier ranks, but are easily blocked by Eosphorus' shields.
units.displayText: Some attacks signifying denial come from the Sanctifier ranks, but are easily blocked by Eosphorus' shields.

spans.text: Some attacks signifying denial come from the Sanctifier ranks, but are easily blocked by Eosphorus' shields.

units.rawText: ...Still set in your ways?
units.displayText: ...Still set in your ways?

spans.text: ...Still set in your ways?

units.rawText: Of course! We will not give up on the fight because of your words!
units.displayText: Of course! We will not give up on the fight because of your words!

spans.text: Of course! We will not give up on the fight because of your words!

units.rawText: A blade's glint strikes forth from a dead zone in Eosphorus' vision, yet it too fails to penetrate his shields.
units.displayText: A blade's glint strikes forth from a dead zone in Eosphorus' vision, yet it too fails to penetrate his shields.

spans.text: A blade's glint strikes forth from a dead zone in Eosphorus' vision, yet it too fails to penetrate his shields.

units.rawText: Judgment? I had thought you would be the first to stand by my side.
units.displayText: Judgment? I had thought you would be the first to stand by my side.

spans.text: Judgment? I had thought you would be the first to stand by my side.

units.rawText: A laughable notion.
units.displayText: A laughable notion.

spans.text: A laughable notion.

units.rawText: Sanctifier Eosphorus, in Judgment's name, I pronounce you guilty of treason against the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Sanctifier Eosphorus, in Judgment's name, I pronounce you guilty of treason against the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Sanctifier Eosphorus, in Judgment's name, I pronounce you guilty of treason against the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Take this!
units.displayText: Take this!

spans.text: Take this!

units.rawText: The Greater Sanctifier swings their blade with all the operands they can bring to bear, attempting to shatter Eosphorus' shields with one strike.
units.displayText: The Greater Sanctifier swings their blade with all the operands they can bring to bear, attempting to shatter Eosphorus' shields with one strike.

spans.text: The Greater Sanctifier swings their blade with all the operands they can bring to bear, attempting to shatter Eosphorus' shields with one strike.

units.rawText: ...I see.
units.displayText: ...I see.

spans.text: ...I see.

units.rawText: I may not be your superior, but I hope you will remember this well.
units.displayText: I may not be your superior, but I hope you will remember this well.

spans.text: I may not be your superior, but I hope you will remember this well.

units.rawText: The weapon in Judgment's hand shatters the moment it comes into contact with Eosphorus' shield.
units.displayText: The weapon in Judgment's hand shatters the moment it comes into contact with Eosphorus' shield.

spans.text: The weapon in Judgment's hand shatters the moment it comes into contact with Eosphorus' shield.

units.rawText: The former Sanctifier leader raises his head, undeniable authority in his golden eyes.
units.displayText: The former Sanctifier leader raises his head, undeniable authority in his golden eyes.

spans.text: The former Sanctifier leader raises his head, undeniable authority in his golden eyes.

units.rawText: The weak have no right to convict the strong.
units.displayText: The weak have no right to convict the strong.

spans.text: The weak have no right to convict the strong.

units.rawText: <size=40>...Damn it!</size>
units.displayText: ...Damn it!

spans.text: ...Damn it!

units.rawText: What happened with Punishment was a pity, but this topic is not one you are qualified to speak on.
units.displayText: What happened with Punishment was a pity, but this topic is not one you are qualified to speak on.

spans.text: What happened with Punishment was a pity, but this topic is not one you are qualified to speak on.

units.rawText: Return to where you belong.
units.displayText: Return to where you belong.

spans.text: Return to where you belong.

units.rawText: A meteor appears from Eosphorus' fingertips, easily striking the Greater Sanctifier down to the ground.
units.displayText: A meteor appears from Eosphorus' fingertips, easily striking the Greater Sanctifier down to the ground.

spans.text: A meteor appears from Eosphorus' fingertips, easily striking the Greater Sanctifier down to the ground.

units.rawText: ...Tch!
units.displayText: ...Tch!

spans.text: ...Tch!

units.rawText: Oh? You can still fight?
units.displayText: Oh? You can still fight?

spans.text: Oh? You can still fight?

units.rawText: I shall use you to plunge them into despair, then.
units.displayText: I shall use you to plunge them into despair, then.

spans.text: I shall use you to plunge them into despair, then.

units.rawText: The reaper up high gestures with his hand, calling forth a meteor embodying despair.
units.displayText: The reaper up high gestures with his hand, calling forth a meteor embodying despair.

spans.text: The reaper up high gestures with his hand, calling forth a meteor embodying despair.

units.rawText: <size=60>No!</size>
units.displayText: No!

spans.text: No!

units.rawText: Judgment stands up and puts up a defense, but his struggles are ever-so-miniscule with the absolute difference in power.
units.displayText: Judgment stands up and puts up a defense, but his struggles are ever-so-miniscule with the absolute difference in power.

spans.text: Judgment stands up and puts up a defense, but his struggles are ever-so-miniscule with the absolute difference in power.

units.rawText: In the very next moment, a great wall of flames burns away the meteor.
units.displayText: In the very next moment, a great wall of flames burns away the meteor.

spans.text: In the very next moment, a great wall of flames burns away the meteor.

units.rawText: You would choose to try and stop me, even knowing you would fail?
units.displayText: You would choose to try and stop me, even knowing you would fail?

spans.text: You would choose to try and stop me, even knowing you would fail?

units.rawText: Of course.
units.displayText: Of course.

spans.text: Of course.

units.rawText: If that is so, then I shall deliver all of you unto despair.
units.displayText: If that is so, then I shall deliver all of you unto despair.

spans.text: If that is so, then I shall deliver all of you unto despair.

units.rawText: The look in his eyes grows colder.
units.displayText: The look in his eyes grows colder.

spans.text: The look in his eyes grows colder.

units.rawText: Being able to manipulate the Sacred Canon of Greater Sanctifiers means I can easily rewrite your Canon as well.
units.displayText: Being able to manipulate the Sacred Canon of Greater Sanctifiers means I can easily rewrite your Canon as well.

spans.text: Being able to manipulate the Sacred Canon of Greater Sanctifiers means I can easily rewrite your Canon as well.

units.rawText: Adamant as you are in your ways, I shall leave Entropization to strip away your remaining Sanctifier dignity.
units.displayText: Adamant as you are in your ways, I shall leave Entropization to strip away your remaining Sanctifier dignity.

spans.text: Adamant as you are in your ways, I shall leave Entropization to strip away your remaining Sanctifier dignity.

units.rawText: With the snap of a finger, Entropic roaring spreads across the battlefield once more.
units.displayText: With the snap of a finger, Entropic roaring spreads across the battlefield once more.

spans.text: With the snap of a finger, Entropic roaring spreads across the battlefield once more.

units.rawText: Although this time, it would emanate from behind Hesperus...
units.displayText: Although this time, it would emanate from behind Hesperus...

spans.text: Although this time, it would emanate from behind Hesperus...

units.rawText: Reverse Babylon Tower, Pantheon.
units.displayText: Reverse Babylon Tower, Pantheon.

spans.text: Reverse Babylon Tower, Pantheon.

units.rawText: Using the shield left by Angelus, the Professor and Antonina struggle to fend off Eucharist.
units.displayText: Using the shield left by Angelus, the Professor and Antonina struggle to fend off Eucharist.

spans.text: Using the shield left by Angelus, the Professor and Antonina struggle to fend off Eucharist.

units.rawText: (How's Angelus?)
units.displayText: How's Angelus?

spans.text: How's Angelus?

units.rawText: (No traces of her stirring... She's probably totally lost in Eucharist's neural space.)
units.displayText: No traces of her stirring... She's probably totally lost in Eucharist's neural space.

spans.text: No traces of her stirring... She's probably totally lost in Eucharist's neural space.

units.rawText: (...The best we can do is prioritize the Sacred Canon and try to make our exit after making sure it isn't Entropized!)
units.displayText: ...The best we can do is prioritize the Sacred Canon and try to make our exit after making sure it isn't Entropized!

spans.text: ...The best we can do is prioritize the Sacred Canon and try to make our exit after making sure it isn't Entropized!

units.rawText: (I know! There's about 1/5 left to deal with in the infected Canon!)
units.displayText: I know! There's about 1/5 left to deal with in the infected Canon!

spans.text: I know! There's about 1/5 left to deal with in the infected Canon!

units.rawText: Not getting serious at a time like this is dangerous, you know?
units.displayText: Not getting serious at a time like this is dangerous, you know?

spans.text: Not getting serious at a time like this is dangerous, you know?

units.rawText: Eucharist appears between the two in their hiding spot, smiling from ear to ear.
units.displayText: Eucharist appears between the two in their hiding spot, smiling from ear to ear.

spans.text: Eucharist appears between the two in their hiding spot, smiling from ear to ear.

units.rawText: Aren't you good at scuttling around like a little bug, Professor? You used to be able to hang with Big Sis Angelus. You must not be feeling so good today.
units.displayText: Aren't you good at scuttling around like a little bug, Professor? You used to be able to hang with Big Sis Angelus. You must not be feeling so good today.

spans.text: Aren't you good at scuttling around like a little bug, Professor? You used to be able to hang with Big Sis Angelus. You must not be feeling so good today.

units.rawText: Ah, could it be that your guard is down with lil' Anna at your side?
units.displayText: Ah, could it be that your guard is down with lil' Anna at your side?

spans.text: Ah, could it be that your guard is down with lil' Anna at your side?

units.rawText: You too, lil' Anna, all focused on the Canon with not a care in the world. It really is boring when I'm the only one taking it seriously.
units.displayText: You too, lil' Anna, all focused on the Canon with not a care in the world. It really is boring when I'm the only one taking it seriously.

spans.text: You too, lil' Anna, all focused on the Canon with not a care in the world. It really is boring when I'm the only one taking it seriously.

units.rawText: Let me help you wake up a little.
units.displayText: Let me help you wake up a little.

spans.text: Let me help you wake up a little.

units.rawText: Eucharist swings her weapon, forming a barrier in its path and bisecting the space. She looks at Antonina before her and the Professor.
units.displayText: Eucharist swings her weapon, forming a barrier in its path and bisecting the space. She looks at Antonina before her and the Professor.

spans.text: Eucharist swings her weapon, forming a barrier in its path and bisecting the space. She looks at Antonina before her and the Professor.

units.rawText: Alright, now it's a one on one. Stop fretting over that program of yours and perk up.
units.displayText: Alright, now it's a one on one. Stop fretting over that program of yours and perk up.

spans.text: Alright, now it's a one on one. Stop fretting over that program of yours and perk up.

units.rawText: ...Aren't you asking for too much from a clerical worker?
units.displayText: ...Aren't you asking for too much from a clerical worker?

spans.text: ...Aren't you asking for too much from a clerical worker?

units.rawText: Alright, I'll give you a three second head start.
units.displayText: Alright, I'll give you a three second head start.

spans.text: Alright, I'll give you a three second head start.

units.rawText: Three, two, one—
units.displayText: Three, two, one—

spans.text: Three, two, one—

units.rawText: She opens her eyes again to find that the green-haired Doll has not moved an inch.
units.displayText: She opens her eyes again to find that the green-haired Doll has not moved an inch.

spans.text: She opens her eyes again to find that the green-haired Doll has not moved an inch.

units.rawText: Time's up, you know? I did give you a chance.
units.displayText: Time's up, you know? I did give you a chance.

spans.text: Time's up, you know? I did give you a chance.

units.rawText: She raises her hands, summoning her shield and fork. It would be all too simple to take care of an agent and she thrusts her weapon directly at the figure in front of her—
units.displayText: She raises her hands, summoning her shield and fork. It would be all too simple to take care of an agent and she thrusts her weapon directly at the figure in front of her—

spans.text: She raises her hands, summoning her shield and fork. It would be all too simple to take care of an agent and she thrusts her weapon directly at the figure in front of her—

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: —It goes straight through the Doll, landing upon the opposite wall.
units.displayText: —It goes straight through the Doll, landing upon the opposite wall.

spans.text: —It goes straight through the Doll, landing upon the opposite wall.

units.rawText: The tan-haired Sanctifier is disoriented for a second, but soon puts on an engrossed smile.
units.displayText: The tan-haired Sanctifier is disoriented for a second, but soon puts on an engrossed smile.

spans.text: The tan-haired Sanctifier is disoriented for a second, but soon puts on an engrossed smile.

units.rawText: Hahahaha, you certainly repurposed my projection generator quickly. Impressive, I must say.
units.displayText: Hahahaha, you certainly repurposed my projection generator quickly. Impressive, I must say.

spans.text: Hahahaha, you certainly repurposed my projection generator quickly. Impressive, I must say.

units.rawText: As expected of lil' Anna, our "creator". You sure are something else.
units.displayText: As expected of lil' Anna, our "creator". You sure are something else.

spans.text: As expected of lil' Anna, our "creator". You sure are something else.

units.rawText: Now, let me have a guess. Just where are you hiding?
units.displayText: Now, let me have a guess. Just where are you hiding?

spans.text: Now, let me have a guess. Just where are you hiding?

units.rawText: I have a lot of clones. The Pantheon also has backdoors I've left in. You won't be able to find me.
units.displayText: I have a lot of clones. The Pantheon also has backdoors I've left in. You won't be able to find me.

spans.text: I have a lot of clones. The Pantheon also has backdoors I've left in. You won't be able to find me.

units.rawText: Hehe, don't be so confident, lil' Anna.
units.displayText: Hehe, don't be so confident, lil' Anna.

spans.text: Hehe, don't be so confident, lil' Anna.

units.rawText: I may not have technology as refined as yours, but violence—
units.displayText: I may not have technology as refined as yours, but violence—

spans.text: I may not have technology as refined as yours, but violence—

units.rawText: Eucharist's shield leaves her hand, carving a perfect arc through the air and pulverizing every piece of cover in its way.
units.displayText: Eucharist's shield leaves her hand, carving a perfect arc through the air and pulverizing every piece of cover in its way.

spans.text: Eucharist's shield leaves her hand, carving a perfect arc through the air and pulverizing every piece of cover in its way.

units.rawText: —Is often an effective method for solving puzzles.
units.displayText: —Is often an effective method for solving puzzles.

spans.text: —Is often an effective method for solving puzzles.

units.rawText: There you are.
units.displayText: There you are.

spans.text: There you are.

units.rawText: As the Pantheon shakes, Antonina's projection disappears. Eucharist stoops, picking up the destroyed projector from the remains of a shattered pillar.
units.displayText: As the Pantheon shakes, Antonina's projection disappears. Eucharist stoops, picking up the destroyed projector from the remains of a shattered pillar.

spans.text: As the Pantheon shakes, Antonina's projection disappears. Eucharist stoops, picking up the destroyed projector from the remains of a shattered pillar.

units.rawText: Hehe, I've wanted to smash up the Pantheon like this for quite some time now. Bless lil' Anna for giving me this chance.
units.displayText: Hehe, I've wanted to smash up the Pantheon like this for quite some time now. Bless lil' Anna for giving me this chance.

spans.text: Hehe, I've wanted to smash up the Pantheon like this for quite some time now. Bless lil' Anna for giving me this chance.

units.rawText: So, the search radius is greatly reduced. If lil' Anna was to deploy the projector and hide in a little cubby in three seconds...
units.displayText: So, the search radius is greatly reduced. If lil' Anna was to deploy the projector and hide in a little cubby in three seconds...

spans.text: So, the search radius is greatly reduced. If lil' Anna was to deploy the projector and hide in a little cubby in three seconds...

units.rawText: Are you behind the bookshelf? Or that wall?
units.displayText: Are you behind the bookshelf? Or that wall?

spans.text: Are you behind the bookshelf? Or that wall?

units.rawText: Knock knock—anyone home?
units.displayText: Knock knock—anyone home?

spans.text: Knock knock—anyone home?

units.rawText: Antonina hides within a passage, turning her operational frequency down to a minimum. She rests her fingers on her keyboard, ready to deliver a deadly blow to Eucharist who might try to destroy the passage at any moment.
units.displayText: Antonina hides within a passage, turning her operational frequency down to a minimum. She rests her fingers on her keyboard, ready to deliver a deadly blow to Eucharist who might try to destroy the passage at any moment.

spans.text: Antonina hides within a passage, turning her operational frequency down to a minimum. She rests her fingers on her keyboard, ready to deliver a deadly blow to Eucharist who might try to destroy the passage at any moment.

units.rawText: The footsteps gradually approach with a rhythmical pitter-patter as the hunter casually approaches her prey.
units.displayText: The footsteps gradually approach with a rhythmical pitter-patter as the hunter casually approaches her prey.

spans.text: The footsteps gradually approach with a rhythmical pitter-patter as the hunter casually approaches her prey.

units.rawText: Antonina silently estimates the distance between the two. Three, two, one—
units.displayText: Antonina silently estimates the distance between the two. Three, two, one—

spans.text: Antonina silently estimates the distance between the two. Three, two, one—

units.rawText: Fwup—
units.displayText: Fwup—

spans.text: Fwup—

units.rawText: What arrives is not Eucharist's attacks, but the radiant light from the Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: What arrives is not Eucharist's attacks, but the radiant light from the Sacred Canon.

spans.text: What arrives is not Eucharist's attacks, but the radiant light from the Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: On the other side of the barrier, the Professor makes the last input on the terminal.
units.displayText: On the other side of the barrier, the Professor makes the last input on the terminal.

spans.text: On the other side of the barrier, the Professor makes the last input on the terminal.

units.rawText: All infected Canon entries processed. Entropization program disarmed.
units.displayText: All infected Canon entries processed. Entropization program disarmed.

spans.text: All infected Canon entries processed. Entropization program disarmed.

units.rawText: I see how it is...
units.displayText: I see how it is...

spans.text: I see how it is...

units.rawText: Alright, you win this game. Next is an intermission. You won't have to worry about any attacks from me.
units.displayText: Alright, you win this game. Next is an intermission. You won't have to worry about any attacks from me.

spans.text: Alright, you win this game. Next is an intermission. You won't have to worry about any attacks from me.

units.rawText: Eucharist closes her eyes and puts her hands up, displaying no intent to attack. Antonina carefully exits the hidden passage, patching into the Canon.
units.displayText: Eucharist closes her eyes and puts her hands up, displaying no intent to attack. Antonina carefully exits the hidden passage, patching into the Canon.

spans.text: Eucharist closes her eyes and puts her hands up, displaying no intent to attack. Antonina carefully exits the hidden passage, patching into the Canon.

units.rawText: ...Looks all good, Canon Entropization rate at 0%.
units.displayText: ...Looks all good, Canon Entropization rate at 0%.

spans.text: ...Looks all good, Canon Entropization rate at 0%.

units.rawText: The Professor lets out a sigh of relief, but a strange uneasiness arises from within.
units.displayText: The Professor lets out a sigh of relief, but a strange uneasiness arises from within.

spans.text: The Professor lets out a sigh of relief, but a strange uneasiness arises from within.

units.rawText: Naturally, I've prepared a prize for the game's winners.
units.displayText: Naturally, I've prepared a prize for the game's winners.

spans.text: Naturally, I've prepared a prize for the game's winners.

units.rawText: Bloodcurdling screeches and wailing come from the Plaza of Oaths. The Professor and Antonina's faces grow dark and they look outside to find the color purple proliferating in the ranks behind Hesperus.
units.displayText: Bloodcurdling screeches and wailing come from the Plaza of Oaths. The Professor and Antonina's faces grow dark and they look outside to find the color purple proliferating in the ranks behind Hesperus.

spans.text: Bloodcurdling screeches and wailing come from the Plaza of Oaths. The Professor and Antonina's faces grow dark and they look outside to find the color purple proliferating in the ranks behind Hesperus.

units.rawText: But why... the Entropization program is already disarmed!
units.displayText: But why... the Entropization program is already disarmed!

spans.text: But why... the Entropization program is already disarmed!

units.rawText: Something comes to Antonina's mind and she makes a rapid series of inputs on her keyboard. The data on the screen soon verifies her assumptions.

units.rawText: Holding fast to their ideals until a moment ago, the Sanctifiers' expressions turn to ones of immeasurable pain. Malignant purple vines sprout forth from their cores, extending across their bodies, sapping away their energy and will to fight.
